sources.verified_claim: Predict fault presence as a single-band float32 GeoTIFF, values [0,1], UTM zone 11N / EPSG:32611, 100 m; use the sample grid. Distance-weighted Tversky has alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular kernel support 300 m. External public data with compatible open licenses are permitted.
